records.source: continue/64 15/farmer 64 16 2 Jodi 64 18 0/pause 1500/addQuest 22/skippable/speak Jodi "*puff* ...hi @! *pant* Whew... that was quite a workout, walking all the way up here.$h"/pause 200/emote Jodi 28/pause 200/speak Jodi "Anyway... I came by to ask if you wanted to have dinner with us tonight!#$b#You don't have to... but if you decide to come, could you please bring a largemouth bass with you?#$b#...that's right. One of those big, slimy fish from the lake. I need one for the casserole I'm making.$h#$b#Okay, well... it'll be at our house at around 7:00 PM tonight... don't forget the largemouth bass! Bye."/pause 300/end dialogue Jodi "Fish casserole always hits the spot."
records.translation: continue/64 15/farmer 64 16 2 Jodi 64 18 0/pause 1500/addQuest 22/skippable/speak Jodi "*hingal* ...kumusta, @! *habol-hininga* Whew... Kailangan ko iyon para sa kaserol na ginagawa ko.$h#$b#Sige... sa bahay namin ito bandang alas-siyete ngayong gabi... huwag mong kalimutan ang Largemouth Bass! Paalam."/pause 300/end dialogue Jodi "Laging masarap ang kaserol na isda."

records.source: continue/64 15/farmer 64 16 2 Pierre 64 18 0/broadcastEvent/skippable/pause 1500/speak Pierre "Hello there, @. So! Your first year in Stardew Valley is almost over, huh?#$b#If you keep buying seeds from me, you'll be twice as productive next year!$h#$b#And I have some exciting news...#$b#I'll be selling new seed varieties in my shop next year! I should have 1 new variety per season.#$b#...Well, that's all I wanted to say. Have a good one."/pause 300/move Pierre 0 1 2/pause 1000/faceDirection Pierre 0/speak Pierre "You know... I wouldn't even bother trying my competitor's seeds.$u#$b# Pierre's seeds are the *highest* quality seeds you'll find anywhere. That's a promise.$h"/pause 500/end
records.translation: continue/64 15/farmer 64 16 2 Pierre 64 18 0/broadcastEvent/skippable/pause 1500/speak Pierre "Kumusta, @. Malapit nang matapos ang unang taon mo sa Stardew Valley, ano?#$b#Kung patuloy kang bibili ng mga binhi sa akin, magiging doble ang produksiyon mo sa susunod na taon!$h#$b#At may kapana-panabik akong balita...#$b#Magbebenta ako ng mga bagong uri ng binhi sa tindahan ko sa susunod na taon! Dapat ay may 1 bagong uri ako bawat panahon.#$b#...Iyon lamang ang gusto kong sabihin. Magandang araw."/pause 300/move Pierre 0 1 2/pause 1000/faceDirection Pierre 0/speak Pierre "Alam mo... Hindi ka na dapat mag-abalang subukan ang mga binhi ng kakumpitensya ko.$u#$b# Ang mga binhi ni Pierre ang may *pinakamataas* na kalidad na makikita mo saanman. Pangako iyan.$h"/pause 500/end

records.source: continue/64 15/farmer 64 16 2 Marnie 64 18 0/pause 1500/addQuest 21/skippable/speak Marnie "Good morning, ${Mr.^Ms.}$ @!$h#$b#I came by to ask you a favor, since you're such a kind neighbor.#$b#You see, I'm trying to train my goats to say 'hello'... but they simply won't pay attention to me unless I have their favorite treat, cave carrots!$u#$b#So... since I'm scared of the mines... I thought, well, maybe you would bring me a cave carrot when you have the chance?#$b#There's no pressure... but if you want to, just swing by my house between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM with a cave carrot. You'll make an old girl very happy. Bye."/pause 300/end dialogue Marnie "My goats go wild over cave carrot... I can't imagine why."
records.translation: continue/64 15/farmer 64 16 2 Marnie 64 18 0/pause 1500/addQuest 21/skippable/speak Marnie "Magandang umaga, ${G.^Bb.}$ @!$h#$b#Dumaan ako upang humingi ng pabor dahil napakabait mong kapitbahay.#$b#Sinisikap kong sanayin ang mga kambing kong bumati ng 'kumusta'... pero hindi nila ako pinapansin maliban kung dala ko ang paborito nilang pagkain, ang mga Karot sa Yungib!$u#$b#Kaya... dahil natatakot ako sa mga Minahan... naisip kong baka maaari mo akong dalhan ng Karot sa Yungib kapag may pagkakataon ka?#$b#Walang pilitan... pero kung gusto mo, dumaan ka lang sa bahay ko sa pagitan ng alas-nuwebe ng umaga at alas-singko ng hapon na may dalang Karot sa Yungib. Mapasasaya mo nang husto ang matandang babaeng ito. Paalam."/pause 300/end dialogue Marnie "Tuwang-tuwa ang mga kambing ko sa Karot sa Yungib... Hindi ko maisip kung bakit."
